definitions.explanation: A container with flat sides, typically square or rectangular.
A container for holding or transporting items.

notes:
{箱|はこ} refers to boxes, cases, and containers - typically with flat sides.

TYPES:
- ⟦{段|だん}ボール→段ボール：18885_danbooru⟧{箱|ばこ}: cardboard box
- ⟦{弁当箱|べんとうばこ}→弁当箱：20186_bentoubako⟧: lunch box
- ⟦{貯金箱|ちょきんばこ}→貯金箱：15345_chokinbako⟧: piggy bank, money box
- ⟦ゴミ{箱|ばこ}→ゴミ箱：06994_gomibako⟧: trash can, bin
- ⟦{道具箱|どうぐばこ}→道具箱：14913_dougubako⟧: toolbox
- ⟦{本箱|ほんばこ}→本箱：27826_honbako⟧: bookshelf
- ⟦{救急箱|きゅうきゅうばこ}→救急箱：19410_kyuukyuubako⟧: first aid kit

COUNTER:
{箱|はこ} itself is used as a counter:
- ⟦{一箱|ひとはこ}→一箱：28497_hitohako⟧: one box
- {二箱|ふたはこ}: two boxes
- {三箱|さんばこ}: three boxes

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {箱|はこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧: to open a box
- {箱|はこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put in a box
- ⟦{箱|はこ}{詰|づ}め→箱詰め：19030_hakozume⟧: boxed, packaged
